mapper.select: SELECT * FROM exam_registration WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND student_id=#{studentId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM exam_registration ORDER BY reg_id DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT r.reg_id, r.student_id, r.class_id, r.project_id, p.activity_type, p.name AS activity_name, p.exam_date AS activity_date, r.result, r.award FROM exam_registration r JOIN exam_project p ON p.project_id = r.project_id WHERE r.result IS NOT NULL AND r.result <> ''
